name: Professional Video Editing
purpose: Real footage of a presenter cut tightly, with keyword captions, B-roll cards, infographics and explanatory 3D models.
techniquesFrom: references/ANALYSIS.md (ref 1) — techniques only; never reuse its footage, people or copy

captions.highlight: one keyword per line on a solid accent block

edit.cards: cursor-drag card swipe, vertical motion-blur exit 0.3 s
edit.letterCascade: Latin labels fall in per letter with blur

elements.3d: glossy PBR objects on white board with soft contact shadow

sound.sfx: whoosh per card, pop per highlight
